mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, COUNT(bt.blog_post_id) AS postCount FROM blog_tag t LEFT JOIN blog_post_tag bt ON bt.blog_tag_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.slug ORDER BY t.name ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, COUNT(*) AS postCount FROM blog_tag t JOIN blog_post_tag bt ON bt.blog_tag_id = t.id JOIN blog_post p ON p.id = bt.blog_post_id WHERE p.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.slug ORDER BY postCount DESC, t.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO blog_tag (name, slug) VALUES (#{tag.name}, #{tag.slug})
